'''Baroc''' was the [[Sea Folk]] [[Master of the Blades]] aboard the ''[[Windrunner]]''. 

== Appearance ==
He has deep set eyes and is just about bald with bits of white hair.

== Activities ==
He is present when [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] come aboard ''Windrunner'' and helps [[Nesta din Reas Two Moons]] bargain over the [[Bowl of the Winds]].

When the [[Seanchan]] attack [[Ebou Dar]], Baroc tries to rebel against them and is executed soon after.
